name: France: telemarketing ranges (ARCEP)
description: Warns about calls from the numbers ARCEP reserved for automated calling platforms (Numéros Polyvalents Vérifiés): 01 62, 01 63, 02 70, 02 71, 03 77, 03 78, 04 24, 04 25, 05 68, 05 69, 09 48, 09 49.
author: Parley

sources.title: Arcep: plan de numérotation pour les professionnels (NPV ranges)

notes: Call centres also use these ranges for customer service and debt collection, so the list only warns.
